evidence: Of 3,248 successful-text artifacts, 116 are high-confidence non-content shells. Sixteen of 449 unique artifacts used by routing affected 15 of 1,100 Events. Every affected reason and Insight remained supported by the X thread or another valid artifact. Jina Reader produced 63 of the 116 shell snapshots, so fallback retrieval alone does not solve the boundary.
impact_next: Treat extraction success as substantive-content eligibility after every retrieval adapter. Quarantine recognized shells; use Jina only after eligible public HTML fails direct retrieval, and fail closed when Reader also returns a shell. Avoid broad rerouting until the affected-item invalidation path is chosen.
tools_spend: Read-only SQLite and local snapshot inspection; no external model, provider, or collection calls and no incremental spend.
